messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] synth-canary 'text-gen-us-east-1' failed checks (failure_rate=31%, threshold=10%) — alerting channel eng-oncall · link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/98765

 sam (oncall): on it. seeing a spike in canary failures since 22:48 UTC, paging now. checking runbook...

 maria (sre): I can help triage. do we know if this is real customer impact or a noisy canary?

 sam (oncall): initial check: host-level looks fine, no infra CPU/gpu pressure. errors are 5xx from model-proxy with `upstream_timeout` and some `model-oom` traces in the last 5m.

 aj (eng-runtime): hmm — we've had a deploy of kv-cache tweaks ~40m ago but nothing else. model instances reported a short GC spike ~22:47 on a couple of hosts, might explain transient OOM-ish responses.

 devin (prod-obs): dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/xyz/canary-overview — you can see the probe failure rate jumps at 22:48 and fades by ~22:56 but then recurs. latency p95 also spikes.

 sam (oncall): paging SRE rotation to engage. @maria can you confirm customer 504s? i see a handful RTT alerts but customer traffic doesn't appear widely impacted yet (few 5xx traces in apm).

 maria (sre): confirmed minimal customer-facing 5xx. majority of failures are from the synthetic probe (same payload). risk: noisy canary causing repeated pages and distracting oncall. recommend mute while we investigate deeper.

 ops-bot: /silence alert 98765 15m — Silence applied by sam (oncall) — reason: investigating noisy canary, temporary mute

 sam (oncall): silenced for 15m to stop alert storms. continuing investigation.

 aj (eng-runtime): quick check: canary frequency is 30s, no jitter, and probes reuse the same model key which can amplify transient cold starts. proposal: increase interval to 2m and add jitter, also change alert to 5m rolling failure rate > 20% instead of per-minute.

 devin (prod-obs): agree on rolling window. also suggest switching alert from raw failure rate to `failure_rate{probe="text-gen-us-east-1"}` over 10m with weight for unique-instance failures (reduce correlated failures from the same host).

 maria (sre): for immediate mitigation we should do: 1) keep canary silenced, 2) spin a targeted run of the probe against a small pool of warm instances, 3) patch probe to rotate model-key per attempt so cache cold-starts don't correlate.

 sam (oncall): executing step 2: running ad-hoc probe job to hit warm pool. results: lower failure rate when sent to warm instances (2%). So this looks like cold-start / cache priming noise.

 aj (eng-runtime): I'll roll back the KV cache change on a canary subset and compare. If rollback reduces GC/oom traces we have root cause.

 rachel (pm): fyi customer metrics team flagged a non-critical blip in a partner integration around 22:50 but they said it recovered quickly. Not seeing escalations from support.

 ops-bot: /run-job probe-rotate-model-key --target=canary-pool --concurrency=5 — job started by sam (oncall)

 devin (prod-obs): job results: rotating model-key lowered correlated failures. adding jitter at probe level dropped failure spikes. new failure rate baseline ~3% for probes.

 aj (eng-runtime): rollback on kv-cache partial flip applied to canary hosts at 22:58. monitoring for GC/oom. initial logs show fewer GC spikes.

 sam (oncall): un-silencing alert now to verify behaviour. ops-bot: /unsilence alert 98765 

 incident-bot: [RECOVERY] synth-canary 'text-gen-us-east-1' recovered (failure_rate=2%, threshold=10%) timestamp=2123460800

 maria (sre): recommend follow-up actions in ticket: 1) change canary interval to 2m + jitter, 2) update alerting to 10m rolling failure rate > 15% with per-instance dedup, 3) probe change to rotate model-key, 4) retro for kv-cache change rollout gating (observability flags).

 rachel (pm): agree. please add customer-impact note and ETA for config rollouts.

 sam (oncall): filing follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-2026 summary=canary-noise-due-to-cache-change-and-probe-config

 devin (prod-obs): I'll own the dashboards/alert update PR. plan: new panel showing per-instance failure heatmap + probe jitter metric.

 aj (eng-runtime): will add feature flag gating and hold kv-cache change for 48h with additional canary validation.

 maria (sre): closing the oncall thread. thanks everyone. :heart:
